name: Dawnwatcher Selgorm
summary: At the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus, Dawnwatcher Selgorm watches for threats across northern Kalimdor. The human serves the Argent Dawn as an observer and liaison in the night elven capital, tracking reports of shadowy cult activity and dark powers stirring nearby.

sections.title: Eyes in the World Tree
sections.body: Dawnwatcher Selgorm keeps watch in Darnassus for the Argent Dawn. The order's fight against the undead Scourge in the Eastern Plaguelands does not end its vigilance elsewhere. From the Craftsmen's Terrace, Selgorm gathers reports of emerging threats in Kalimdor's wilds. He connects the night elves with the wider effort against ancient evil and seeks Alliance travelers able to strike at cultists and dark powers before their influence spreads.

sections.title: A Strike Against Darkness
sections.body: Blackfathom Deeps, beneath the Zoram Strand in Ashenvale, draws Selgorm's attention. The Twilight's Hammer cult and serpentine naga have gathered in the flooded ruins. Selgorm rewards seasoned champions who venture there, targeting the cult's leaders and reclaiming tainted relics in hopes of quelling the shadows threatening Kalimdor's sacred shores.

faq.answer: Dawnwatcher Selgorm is a human agent of the Argent Dawn, stationed in Darnassus to watch for encroaching evil across Kalimdor.

faq.q: Where can Dawnwatcher Selgorm be found?
faq.answer: Dawnwatcher Selgorm can be found outdoors on the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus, overlooking the night elven capital's workshops.

faq.q: Why is an Argent Dawn member stationed in Darnassus?
faq.answer: The Argent Dawn fights the Scourge in Lordaeron and seeks to root out malevolence everywhere. In Darnassus, Selgorm watches for rising cult activity, including the Twilight's Hammer in northern Kalimdor.

faq.q: What does Selgorm ask adventurers to do?
faq.answer: Selgorm awaits Alliance heroes returning from Blackfathom Deeps in Ashenvale with the head of Twilight Lord Kelris, the Twilight's Hammer leader there. The wounded Argent Guard Thaelrid urges them to slay Kelris and stop the cult's corruption from spreading.

angles.text: As an Alliance adventurer exploring northern Kalimdor, you can look to Selgorm as a link between Darnassus and the fight against sinister cults along the coast.
As a human traveling among Teldrassil's remote boughs, you may find a fellow countryman serving the Argent Dawn.
